dialogues.speaker: Wakui
dialogues.en: "If there's nothing else, you may begin."
dialogues.text: "If there's nothing else, you may begin."

dialogues.jp:
講師の言葉に学生たちが一斉に動き出す。裏に
していたテスト用紙を表に返し、シャーペンを
走らせる。
dialogues.en:
At the teacher's approval, all the students started moving
at once to the rear, to get the test paper and to sharpen
their pencils.
dialogues.text:
At the teacher's approval, all the students started moving
at once to the rear, to get the test paper and to sharpen
their pencils.

dialogues.jp: 俺もプリントを表に返し、問題を確認する。
dialogues.en:
I take a copy of the test paper and flip it around, looking
at the questions.
dialogues.text:
I take a copy of the test paper and flip it around, looking
at the questions.

dialogues.jp:
数学は、公式を覚えればあとはそれを当てはめ
るだけ……。
dialogues.en: Maths is almost entirely about remembering the formulas...
dialogues.text: Maths is almost entirely about remembering the formulas...

dialogues.jp:
（……のハズなんだけど、それがムズイんだよ
　な）
dialogues.en: "(...Which doesn't make it any less difficult.)"
dialogues.text: "(...Which doesn't make it any less difficult.)"

dialogues.jp:
周りのシャーペンの音に急かされながら、軽く
唇を舐めてペンをかまえた。
dialogues.en:
With the sound of pencils being sharpened all around me, I
place my pen lightly on my lips.
dialogues.text:
With the sound of pencils being sharpened all around me, I
place my pen lightly on my lips.

dialogues.jp:
数学は公式さえ覚えれば、後はそれに当てはめ
るだけ……ってわかっていても、それができな
い身の辛さ。
dialogues.en:
As long as you know the formulas, you can do the problems...
so if one has managed to remember them, you're halfway
there.
dialogues.text:
As long as you know the formulas, you can do the problems...
so if one has managed to remember them, you're halfway
there.
